entries.description: A much smaller download, with the same features

changelog.title: Improved
items: The app is about 30 MB smaller to download and install
Removed an unused part that only older builds of Your DJ needed

entries.description: Checking for updates works on a weak signal, and you can always download the latest version

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Checking for updates tries again once before it gives up, so a weak signal no longer shows the update server as down
The website's Android download now gives you the latest version, not an older one

changelog.title: Improved
items: When the check fails, Updates offers to download the latest version straight away

entries.description: A cleaner home-screen widget that plays your playlists, Spotify imports that come back whole, and a tidier Stream header and profile menu

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Tapping a playlist on the home-screen widget now plays it, including playlists made on the website or on another device
When a playlist can't start, the widget says why, and you can tap the message to open it in the app
The widget's play, skip and like buttons keep working after you swipe the app away
Importing a Spotify playlist again after you deleted it brings back every song, in the same order as Spotify
Lyrics found online, such as Tamil lyric sites, now show up in seconds instead of after a long wait, including in the lyrics picker

changelog.title: Improved
items: The Now playing widget is a compact dark card with the cover, song, time and play controls
The playlist widget is simpler, with cover art and short labels
Playlists opens with New playlist and Import from Spotify at the top
The Transfer button sits above your Spotify playlists, so you no longer scroll past them
The Songs and Playlists switch in Stream is a little smaller and slides smoothly, and the six tiles under it slide with it
Swipe the tiles in Stream's Jump back in to switch between Songs and Playlists, and the switch follows your finger
Connect devices opens on a solid dark sheet instead of a see-through one
The updates menu from the LuvLyrics logo shows Update and Install at the top, and Recent updates folds open with an arrow
The profile menu is a neater side menu, without Blends, LuvLink and Connect devices, which Create and the Stream header already have
The bottom bar fades into the page instead of sitting on a solid black block
Removed leftover code the app no longer uses

entries.description: Large display size keeps the full screen and bottom navigation visible

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Large display size no longer cuts off the right edge or bottom navigation on affected phones
